# WOS PARA instructions

This repository is an Obsidian work vault organized with PARA.

## Source of truth

- Markdown, Base, Canvas, and attachment files in this repository are authoritative.
- QMD indexes and Graphify outputs are generated artifacts.
- Never modify the original vault at `/Users/elroseo/Work GitHub`.

## Organization

- `00 Inbox`: temporary captures awaiting classification
- `10 Projects`: active outcomes with a finish line
- `20 Areas`: ongoing responsibilities and standards
- `30 Resources`: reusable knowledge and reference material
- `40 Archives`: inactive material retained for history
- `90 System`: templates, indexes, and vault maintenance

Use the classification rules in `PARA Guide.md`. Preserve note content and wikilinks when moving files.

## Tool selection

- Use the Obsidian skills for Obsidian Markdown, Bases, Canvas, and CLI operations.
- Use QMD before broad file searches when retrieving vault knowledge.
- Use Graphify when investigating relationships among notes, concepts, people, projects, or systems.

## Privacy

Treat all vault contents as private work information. Do not publish the repository or copy vault content into public issues, pull requests, or external services.
